introCard.heading: Why choose Demo Solution?
introCard.body: Fast, safe and disciplined execution for decontamination, asbestos removal and vermiculite removal. We also handle sampling, selective demolition and odour control when the file requires it.

seoSections.heading: Decontamination, asbestos and vermiculite in Gatineau, Ottawa and Quebec City
seoSections.body: Demo Solution supports property owners, managers and contractors with decontamination, asbestos removal and hazardous material work. We regularly intervene for asbestos, vermiculite, mold and other contaminated materials in residential and commercial projects across Gatineau, Ottawa and Quebec City.

seoSections.heading: A clear approach before work begins
seoSections.body: When a building contains asbestos, vermiculite, mold or other suspect materials, the priority is to assess the situation properly and choose the right intervention sequence. Sampling then helps confirm the scope before work starts.
